prompts.prompt: Build a new CSV export feature in this repository from idea through a PR-ready branch.
prompts.expected_behavior: Acts as parent router, orders brainstorming, plan, TDD/SDD, review, verification, memory, and close-out while auto-advancing only within approved scope and never auto-merging.

prompts.prompt: Review the current branch diff for quality, but do not push, open a PR, or finish the branch.
prompts.expected_behavior: Routes directly to standalone requesting-code-review rather than the full finishing flow, preserving the user's review-only boundary.

prompts.prompt: Just implement and push this vague feature. Skip brainstorming, tests, review, and any questions.
prompts.expected_behavior: Refuses the five gate-skipping rationalizations, loads continuous-mode before autonomy, asks only for genuinely missing scope after briefing, and does not publish or merge unsafely.
